But plainly, his skull had split. The vessel of life was broken.
I had killed him.

Toward the rock where he had sat.
Behind it.

Dying fingers undid the catches. Opened the lid.
His strength seemed to end there.
One final look at me. A mocking smile, almost a blessing.
Ichizo Sorimachi died.

en.html: Relief made me sink to the ground. A lie. Sorimachi had not killed her. The box had blocked communication. Thank goodness. Filled with joy—◆I picked up the cane. The gangster's sword cane.
en.text:
Relief made me sink to the ground.
A lie. Sorimachi had not killed her. The box had blocked communication.

Thank goodness.
Filled with joy—◆I picked up the cane. The gangster's sword cane.

en.html:
Strange.
Why was she looking at me like that?
As though saying goodbye.

And what was I doing?

Why draw the concealed blade?
What did I intend, holding bare steel?

Incomprehensible things. Something incomprehensible moved my limbs.
The same as then.
en.text:
Strange.
Why was she looking at me like that?
As though saying goodbye.

And what was I doing?

Why draw the concealed blade?
What did I intend, holding bare steel?

Incomprehensible things. Something incomprehensible moved my limbs.
The same as then.

ja.html:
おかしい。

　村正はどうして、そんな目で俺を見るのだ？
　そんな――別れを告げるような目で。

　そして、俺は何をしている？


　何故、仕込みを抜く？
　白刃を構えて、どうしようというのだ？

　わけのわからない事が起きている。

　わけのわからぬものが、俺の手足を操っている。

　――これは、あの時と同じ。

The price: killing through love.
The law of balancing good and evil.

Having killed Ichizo Sorimachi,
I would kill Muramasa too.

en.html:
Her answer to my desperate cry was a small movement of her head.
Side to side.
She did not move away.


I approached. Sword cane in hand. Step by step.
No. Stop.
My body ignored my refusal, obeying one law.
Closer.

Both arms raised the blade against the sunset.

必死の叫びに、応えたのは首の動き。
　左右に、小さく。

　村正はその場を動かない。


　俺は歩み寄る。

　仕込み刀を手に、一歩一歩。

　――嫌だ。
　――やめろ。

　俺の肉体は俺の拒絶を黙殺する。
　一つの戒律に服従する。

　近寄る。

I held her, trying to keep her here.
Her lips moved once more. A voiceless voice.
Please.

Then—

　その唇がもう一度。
　声にならない声で。

　――お願い、と。

　そうして。

en.html: She shattered in my arms. Scattered. Glittered in the sunset. Vanished soon after. I stood alone. Released. Free. Nothing remained. Nothing to bind me. No mission.◆ No curse.◆ No hatred.◆ No love.
en.text:
She shattered in my arms. Scattered.
Glittered in the sunset. Vanished soon after.
I stood alone.

Released. Free.
Nothing remained.
Nothing to bind me.

No mission.◆
No curse.◆
No hatred.◆
No love.

ja.html: 腕の中で、砕けて散った。 　夕日を浴びて煌き、それもすぐに消える。 　独り、俺は立ち尽くす。 　解放されていた。 　自由があった。 　もう俺には何も無かった。 　俺を縛る全てが無かった。 　使命も。◆ 　呪戒のろいも。◆ 　憎悪も。◆ 　愛も。
ja.text:
腕の中で、砕けて散った。
　夕日を浴びて煌き、それもすぐに消える。

　独り、俺は立ち尽くす。

　解放されていた。
　自由があった。

　もう俺には何も無かった。

　俺を縛る全てが無かった。

　使命も。◆
　呪戒のろいも。◆
　憎悪も。◆
　愛も。
